Fusing means an epilogue hook inside the gemm profile, which is the gemm lane's call

kernel_ridge_fit_host uploads X, forms K, factors and downloads, once per alpha. A cross-validation over 20 alphas therefore forms the kernel matrix 20 times, and it need form it once.
